meta.notes: v0.1 ships a small AI roster with distinct personalities. Add objects to expand; do not dump placeholder names. Hidden legends stay hidden until intel or calendar reveals them.

playerTemplate.title: Wanderer
playerTemplate.bio: A civilian who did not get out before the airlift windows closed.

backgrounds.name: Bush Scout
backgrounds.blurb: Knows drainages, caches, and when to stay off a ridgeline.

backgrounds.name: Town Organizer
backgrounds.blurb: Can turn a meeting hall into a ration desk.

backgrounds.name: Range Fighter
backgrounds.blurb: Hunting seasons were not sport. They were practice.

backgrounds.name: Hall Speaker
backgrounds.blurb: People listen when the lights are out and the list is short.

aggressive.label: Aggressive
aggressive.blurb: Seeks contact. Drills and marches before talking.

cautious.label: Cautious
cautious.blurb: Builds walls and waits for a sure opening.

diplomat.label: Diplomat
diplomat.blurb: Treaties first. Will fight if boxed in.

merchant.label: Merchant
merchant.blurb: Gold and grain are a kind of ammunition.

loyalist.label: Loyalist
loyalist.blurb: Holds the line for whoever currently feeds the town.

ambitious.label: Ambitious
ambitious.blurb: Wants a bigger chair. May listen to a better offer.

officers.name: Daren Voss
officers.title: Occupation Colonel
officers.bio: Spearhead of the Bowl landing. Treats delay as insubordination.

officers.name: Petra Rusk
officers.title: Slope Major
officers.bio: Holds the oil like a vault. Will not gamble the pipeline on a raid.

officers.name: Cal Nenko
officers.title: Peninsula Sergeant
officers.bio: Local conscript who stayed when the officers flew. Follows the last order given.

officers.name: Harlan Pike
officers.title: Interior Captain
officers.bio: Wants to punch south before the occupiers finish digging in.

officers.name: Yuna Iktuk
officers.title: River Guide
officers.bio: Keeps families fed and unlisted. Dislikes speeches and uniforms.

officers.name: Rhee Solano
officers.title: Harbor Captain
officers.bio: Still talks like a capital exists. Collects favors the way others collect rifles.

officers.name: Maris Quell
officers.title: Ferry Factor
officers.bio: If it floats, she can price it. Occupation scrip, fish, and silence.

officers.name: Mira Solen
officers.title: Night Pilot
officers.bio: Flies dead-reckoning corridors. Sells what she sees to whoever pays in fuel.

officers.name: Tobias Wren
officers.title: Signals Hand
officers.bio: Keeps a civil tongue on an uncivil net. Prefers bargains to ambushes.

officers.name: Oleg Brant
officers.title: Island Commander
officers.bio: Wants Kodiak to outrank the Bowl. A dangerous ally for anyone but himself.

officers.name: Lena Ostrov
officers.title: Harbor Guns
officers.bio: Will not leave the island batteries. The sea, she says, is already a wall.

officers.name: Eli Hart
officers.title: Volunteer
officers.bio: School-shop teacher with a rifle and a list of names still in town.

officers.name: Sable Quinn
officers.title: Road Agent
officers.bio: Runs the Sterling Highway at night. Will sign on if the pay and the legend match.

officers.name: Ilya Karr
officers.title: Slope Ghost
officers.bio: Old ranging contractor. Some maps still have his traplines. He does not answer radios.
